items.title: Wearable heart health technology is revolutionizing cardiovascular monitoring
items.description: Learn about the latest advancements in heart health tracking and how devices like smartwatches and heart rate monitors can help you stay informed and active

items.title: Beware of Avoiding Gluten If You Don't Have Celiac Disease
items.description: If you don’t have celiac disease or a gluten sensitivity, eliminating gluten from your diet can cause nutritional deficiencies.

items.title: Better Heart Health Means More Birthdays... and That's a Good Thing
items.description: There's a sort-of consensus out there that once you hit a certain age, you don't really look forward to your birthdays. Especially when you hit 40, 50, 60 or higher. David Larsen, one of the firefighters competing in the 2014 My Heart Challenge, celebrated his 40th birthday this past week

items.title: The Benefits of Recovery – It Does Your Body (AND YOUR GAME) Good
items.description: As the fall sports season comes to a close, some of you may start to think of upcoming tournaments, travel plans, and holidays. For athletes and parents, now is the time to think…recovery.

items.title: 7 Unconventional Ways to Squeeze in More Exercise
items.description: Workouts can be tough. But exercise doesn’t have to be. For a healthier lifestyle, being active is the key, and it doesn’t much matter what that physical activity is. So if running a half marathon seems overwhelming to you, try one of these unconventional ways to squeeze more exercise into your week.

items.title: 7 simple steps for a healthier life – and heart
items.description: The American Heart Association has defined ideal cardiovascular health based on seven risk factors (Life's Simple 7) that people can improve through lifestyle changes.

items.title: 7 Questions You’ve Always Had About Blood Pressure
7 Misconceptions About Midwives
items.description: Midwives have been caring for women for centuries. But until the 1940s, history tells us they were generally local women with good hearts and instincts, but no formal education. Times have changed, as has the scope of midwifery practice.
